g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS hybrid workloads over Direct Connect with Route 53 Resolver and Storage Gateway

g.title: None.None.Node.35
g.text: Flow: Staff use the ERP app
A member of staff opens the ERP application
The office router sends it over Direct Connect; the VPN takes over if the link fails
A transit virtual interface carries it to the Direct Connect gateway
and on to the Transit Gateway
which delivers it to the VPC's attachment
sends it to an EC2 application server
which reads the Multi-AZ RDS for Oracle database
The office DNS servers forward aws.example.internal to the Resolver inbound endpoint over Direct Connect
which answers from the private hosted zone
Queries from AWS for corp.example.com match a forwarding rule
and the outbound endpoint sends them to the office DNS servers
The on-premises File Gateway serves SMB shares and uploads changes
through the Storage Gateway interface endpoint, over Direct Connect
Each file share is stored in S3
AWS Backup copies the EC2 servers and the database to a vault every night
